text: Obtain a licensed appraisal of Property A (date-of-death value will matter for basis).
Identify the decedent's Prop 13 base-year value from the Assessor (drives the Prop 19 benefit).
Ask an estate attorney to confirm trust terms, probate status and whether a Form 706 is needed.
Get landlord and homeowners insurance quotes for Property A (blank in the model).
Collect 6-12 months of water, electricity and solar bills for Property A (enter in the inputs).
Collect comparable rentals for a Cupertino house of similar size; set the rent multiple.
Confirm the decedent's total gross estate is below $15,000,000 (2026 basic exclusion). Keep figures internal.
Decide whether the household will occupy Property A (the single biggest driver; see Criteria).
Consider a rebuild of the Git history to replace the public author email (requires owner approval; see F21).
Review the staged path (M3) against a 2008-type entry before choosing it; it is a timing bet, not a guarantee.
